title: The Share a Collection Run Lifts on a Renew Business Asset Buyback Agreement
content:
The share the run lifts follows the room the run has left on the quote, counted in calendar days from the day the units are settled to the last day the quote may be accepted, because the machines must reach the retailer while the quote still stands.

1. Where the last day the quote may be accepted falls within the programme's pickup lead days, the run is a spot lift and the share the run lifts is the spot share, being 75 per cent.
2. Where that day falls at or beyond the programme's pickup lead days but within the consolidated notice days, the run is a lane lift and the share the run lifts is the lane share, being 90 per cent.
3. Where that day falls at or beyond the consolidated notice days, the run is a consolidated lift and the share the run lifts is the whole share, being 100 per cent.

The consolidated notice days are 21 days. The programme's pickup lead days are the days of notice a bulk collection needs on the Renew programme the agreement is written under.

**The two boundaries, on both sides.**

| Room left on the quote, in calendar days | The run is | The share the run lifts |
| --- | --- | --- |
| fewer than the programme's pickup lead days | a spot lift | 75 per cent |
| exactly the programme's pickup lead days, up to fewer than 21 days | a lane lift | 90 per cent |
| exactly 21 days or more | a consolidated lift | 100 per cent |

A day count standing exactly at the programme's pickup lead days is at that figure and not within it, so such a run is a lane lift and not a spot lift. A day count standing at exactly 21 days is at the consolidated notice days and not within them, so such a run is a consolidated lift and not a lane lift.

**Hypothetical illustration.** On a Renew Business Asset Buyback agreement, whose pickup lead days are 5, a run settled 1 calendar day before the last day the quote may be accepted is a spot lift at 75 per cent; one settled 5 days before is a lane lift at 90 per cent; one settled 20 days before is still a lane lift at 90 per cent; and one settled 21 days before is a consolidated lift at 100 per cent.
